summary: Tested the session items on backend and frontend. Backend: 9/9 tests passed in the new pytest file, and 5/5 in the existing test_l06_sample_kind_l08_returns_hub.py. UI checks: scheduler KPI, alias tab highlighting, unified Retur hub (4 tabs, deep links, role access), Retur Pelanggan draft smoke, and POS Pesanan Sample (desktop + mobile 390x844). One real bug found: the Catalogue modal opened from the POS quick view does not keep the selected customer or the auto-filled article (both show '— pilih —'), on desktop and mobile. Two minor backend issues on Sales Returns: rejecting a draft gives HTTP 500, and a draft cannot be cancelled or deleted.

minor.issue: Calling it on a DRAFT return gives HTTP 500. return_state.assert_transition raises ValueError ('draft' → 'rejected' not allowed) and the router does not catch it. It should return 400/409 with the message.

There is no cancel or delete endpoint for sales returns, although the state machine allows draft→cancelled. Users cannot throw away a mistaken draft, and the tester had to remove test draft SRET-00004 directly from Mongo.

ui_bugs.component: CatalogueCreateModal (opened from SampleKindChooser in ProductQuickView and MobileQuickView)
ui_bugs.issue: Customer and article are not pre-filled. Both selects show '— pilih —'. React props confirm KNSelect value='' even though SampleKindChooser receives templateId=ptpl_36967cf5513b and customerId=cust_acea95611294. The preview list still appears, which is misleading: the user sees a composition but the 'Buat' button errors with 'Pilih pelanggan, artikel...'. If the user picks customer and article by hand, the order is created correctly (KSC/SOS-00012, 13 yd, then cancelled).

integration_issues.issue: No success feedback. SampleKindChooser does not pass onCreated, so after a successful create the modal just closes with no toast and no SOS number shown.

verified_ok: GET /api/scheduler/summary notifications_unread = 45, same as Mongo count({read:{$ne:true},'read_by.0':{$exists:false}}). UI card sched-kpi-notif shows '45 belum dibaca siapa pun · 0 eskalasi terbuka'.

Alias tab highlighting: ?view=permission-matrix → hub-tab-entities-access aria-current=page, and the inner tab entities-access-tab-roles is selected. ?view=inspections → hub-tab-qc-inspection. ?view=interco-transfers → hub-tab-operations. ?view=entities-access → normal highlighting.

Retur hub (admin): sidebar 'Retur' opens 4 tabs (hub-tab-returns / interco-returns / purchase-returns / return-policies). Each loads without page errors and the active tab is highlighted. Deep links ?view=returns|purchase-returns|interco-returns|return-policies land in the hub. No return tabs found in Pesanan, Pengaturan, Hutang Pemasok or Antar Entitas hubs (code: return views exist only in hubTabs returns-hub).

Role access: sales@ → only Retur Pelanggan; the tab bar is hidden because there is a single tab, and the other return views redirect to sales-home. finance@ → Retur Pelanggan + Retur Antar-PT; purchase-returns and return-policies redirect. API: sales@ GET /sales-returns 200, finance@ GET /interco/returns 200.

Retur Pelanggan smoke: create-return-btn → return-order-select (KSC/SO-00002 shipped) → item-roll-<rollId> chips appear → qty fills to 117.37 after picking a roll → saved as draft with submit-now-check unchecked (SRET-00004, POST 200). The draft was then removed from the DB.

POS desktop: quickview-kind-sample → quickview-sample-kinds with standard (maks 5 yard), hanger (maks 0,5 yard), catalogue (1 yd/warna + 2 yd soft). Quick view caps qty (hanger 3→0.5, standard 8→5). Adding to cart works and the badge shows 'Keranjang Sample'. While the cart holds sample lines, quickview-kind-regular is disabled. In checkout step 2, switching the line to hanger with 4 yd shows sample-over-limit-<pid> with a 'Jadikan ecer' (sample-to-retail-<pid>) button. A knit (kg) product has the catalogue button disabled, and standard/hanger show 'maks 2 kg'.

Server: standard 5.5 yd and hanger 0.6 yd → 400 detail.code=SAMPLE_LIMIT (max_qty 5 / 0.5). A regular order containing an is_sample line → 400 SAMPLE_MIXED. Catalogue preview for a kg template → 400 CATALOGUE_UNIT. Catalogue create works; total = colours + 2, and the order appears in GET /sample-orders and in the Pesanan Sample menu (?view=sample-orders).

POS mobile 390x844: MobileQuickView shows mobile-quickview-sample-kind-standard|hanger|catalogue with the same limits, hanger qty is capped at 0.5, and Catalogue opens the modal (same prefill bug as desktop).
action_items: HIGH: Fix the CatalogueCreateModal prefill. Likely cause: on the first render customers and templates are still empty, so KNSelect takes the Radix path (fewer than 6 options) with a value that matches no item. Radix then calls onValueChange(''), which wipes form.customer_id and form.template_id. The preview request already sent then resolves and leaves a stale preview on screen. Possible fixes: apply initialCustomerId/initialTemplateId after the options load, or in KNSelect ignore onValueChange('') when the current value is not in the options. Also clear the preview when template_id becomes empty after an async response arrives.
Pass onCreated from SampleKindChooser (desktop + mobile) and show a toast with the SOS number, or navigate to Pesanan Sample.

Sales returns: map the ValueError from reject_return (and other return_state transitions) to HTTP 409. Add a cancel action for drafts (POST /sales-returns/{id}/cancel, draft→cancelled) plus a UI button.
Optional: ?view=sales-returns is not a registered view and falls back to the home page. Add an alias to returns if old links or notifications use it (none found in the DB right now).
critical_code_review_comments: CatalogueCreateModal: the preview useEffect has no stale-response guard. A preview from an old template_id can be shown after the template is cleared.
finance@ sees the Retur Pelanggan tab even though hubTabs roles for 'returns' are [admin, sales, manager]. Visibility probably comes from permissions (sales_return.view). Confirm this is intended.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 pytest); 2 minor issues found outside the pytest scope
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; Catalogue prefill broken on desktop + mobile)

To retest the catalogue fix: open the quick view → kind-sample → sample-kind-catalogue, then check that catalogue-customer and catalogue-template show the preselected values. In the browser tool, avoid '\n' and str() inside scripts (they break the wrapper).
rca of the issue: Catalogue prefill: the modal sets form.template_id and form.customer_id from the initial props when it opens, which starts the preview fetch. At that moment the options lists are empty, so both KNSelects use the Radix Select path with a value that matches no item. Radix fires onValueChange('') and the form values are cleared. The earlier preview request then resolves after preview was set to null, so a stale preview stays visible. Evidence: React fiber props show KNSelect value='' while SampleKindChooser props hold templateId/customerId. Repro: POS → choose customer → ATHENA STRETCH → Pesanan Sample → Catalogue.
